attestations.note: doxologia.ro keeps him on the same menologion day as the Russian calendar's «Мчч. Памфила и Капитона», and prints the pair on that day as the Russian calendar does, so this is a row on this folder. His page opens no Viață tab; what it prints of him is one sentence. Read 24 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Πάμφιλος και Καπίτων»

attestations.note: The second of the pair in the listing line, with his own head line on the shared page, «Αγιος Καπιτων». The page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's other rows already carry. The whole of its prose is one sentence — «Οι Άγιοι Πάμφιλος και Καπίτων μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους» — so it adds no year, no place and no hymn of any kind, and no `dates` object is proposed. The page offers no gloss on this name at all, where it glosses most others. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for the civil week 23–29 August 2026 (10–16 August ст. ст.), which names other saints; its page for this saint’s day was not read (2026-08-23).
